1.Name: Wrizz
1.CharacterInfo: Wrizz the Desecrator, the infamous goblin corpse looter whose guile is matched only by his unquenchable thirst for all things gold, will do whatever it takes to get his hands on the shiny stuff. Wrizz will often be found lurking in war-torn areas of the kingdom looting the valiant fallen heroes of Esperia, so that he can make what was once theirs his own. Wrizz although skittish by nature is adequately equipped to defend himself if required and the utmost caution should be used when approaching him.

2.Name: Dune Destroyer
2.CharacterInfo: The Corruptors were born out of the elemental imbalance. The sole meaning of their existence is to hunt down bearers of Elemental Emblems.

3.Name: Apostle of Grudges
3.CharacterInfo: Fear craves pain, screams in praise of despair; the raven cries, mocking life.

4.Name: Fortune Firecrackers
4.CharacterInfo: The Firecracker Arena is a custom of Harmony City. Participants must overcome the hurdles guarded by the stone lion and light the firecrackers. The player who lights the most firecrackers and produces the loudest blast will receive the greatest blessings!
